name: morph-select
title: Morph Select
description: A select whose field stretches open into its list; a highlight glides to your pick as it folds back.

perf.budget: A modal of plain views: the panel height and every row read one shared value, and one more moves the highlight. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: p99 spikes are the first frame of the modal window opening.

a11y.reducedMotion: The list opens and closes at once and the highlight jumps.
a11y.screenReader: A button that reads the label and the current choice and says whether it is expanded; options are menu items with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: The field is 52 pt tall and each option 48 pt.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { MorphSelect } from '@/components/kinetik/morph-select';

<MorphSelect
  label="Time zone"
  options={[
    { value: 'lis', label: 'Lisbon', description: 'UTC+0' },
    { value: 'ist', label: 'Istanbul', description: 'UTC+3' },
  ]}
  value={zone}
  onValueChange={setZone}
/>;
```

## When to use

- One choice from a list of about four to twenty options in a form: a country, a time zone, a size.
- Places where the options need a second line of detail.

## When not to use

- Two to five options people should compare at a glance. Use Choice Cards or a segmented control.
- Long lists that need search. Use a searchable picker screen.

## Notes

- The trigger is measured and the panel grows out of it in its own modal, so it floats above everything and Back or a tap outside closes it.
- The panel opens upwards when there is no room below.
- Past `maxVisible` rows the list scrolls. Disabled options stay visible but cannot be chosen.
- With reduced motion the list opens and closes at once.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add morph-select`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
